info.title: fuse
info.description: A .NET-native codebase context optimizer for AI-assisted development. Fuse collects source files, reduces them for token efficiency, and emits a single structured payload that an agent or developer can consume in one call. Available as a global tool and an MCP server.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: A flexible file combining tool for developers.

commands.name: init
commands.description: Create a fuse.json configuration file in the current directory.

commands.name: mcp
commands.description: Manage the Fuse Model Context Protocol server: install (register with a client) and serve (stdio server).

commands.name: install
commands.description: Register Fuse as an MCP server with Claude Code, Cursor, or GitHub Copilot.

options.name: --client
options.description: AI client to configure: claude, cursor, copilot, or all (default: all). [default: all]

options.name: --scope
options.description: Registration scope: project (this directory) or user (all projects for this user). [default: project]

options.name: --command
options.description: Executable the client launches (default: the running fuse binary or fuse on PATH).

options.name: --rules
options.description: Also write a project rule that biases the agent toward the fuse_* tools (CLAUDE.md, .cursor/rules/fuse.mdc, .github/copilot-instructions.md). Recommended. [default: False]

commands.name: serve
commands.description: Start the Fuse MCP server for AI agent integration. Communicates via stdio using the Model Context Protocol.

commands.name: reduce
commands.description: Reduce specific files (--files) or piped content (--stdin) and print the compacted result to stdout.

options.name: --files
options.description: File paths to reduce (space-separated). Mutually exclusive with --stdin.

options.name: --stdin
options.description: Read content to reduce from stdin instead of files. Mutually exclusive with --files. [default: False]

options.name: --ext
options.description: Extension that selects the reducer for --stdin content (for example .cs, .ts, .py). [default: .cs]

options.name: --level
options.description: C# reduction level: none, standard, aggressive, skeleton, publicApi. [default: Standard]

options.name: --directory
options.description: Base directory for resolving relative --files paths. [default: <path>]

options.name: --max-tokens
options.description: Maximum tokens the reduced output may use (0 = no limit).

options.description: Session id for session-delta emission: omit files already sent under this id.

options.name: --semantic
options.description: Use the Roslyn precision tier for C# (framework-dependent build only). [default: False]

options.name: --git-stats
options.description: Include git churn and last-modified stats in the manifest. [default: False]

options.name: --provenance
options.description: Annotate entries with dependency inclusion provenance. [default: False]

options.name: --dedup-headers
options.description: Replace identical leading comment headers shared across files with a marker, emitted once. [default: False]

options.name: --dedup-bodies
options.description: Replace member bodies identical across files with a marker referencing the canonical copy, keeping every signature. [default: False]

options.name: --embeddings
options.description: Embedding backend for --rerank: true for the semantic ONNX model (downloaded once), false for hashing. Ignored in the Native AOT build.

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format: xml, markdown, json, or compact.

options.name: --tokenizer
options.description: Tokenizer model or encoding (default: o200k_base).

options.name: --report
options.description: Write a machine-readable JSON run report to a file path, or to stdout with '-'.

options.name: --no-redact
options.description: Disable secret redaction (redaction is on by default). [default: False]

options.name: --redact-report
options.description: Append a redaction count summary to the output. [default: False]

options.name: --exclude-files
options.description: Exclude specific file names (e.g., appsettings.Development.json).

options.name: --exclude-patterns
options.description: Exclude files matching glob patterns (e.g., **/Migrations/**, **/*.min.js).

options.name: --exclude-empty-files
options.description: Skip empty (zero-byte) files. [default: True]

options.name: --exclude-auto-generated
options.description: Skip files containing an auto-generated code marker in the first few lines. [default: True]

options.name: --changed-since
options.description: Git ref (branch, commit, HEAD~N) to scope fusion to changed files.

options.name: --include-dependents
options.description: Include first-degree dependents of changed files. [default: True]

options.name: --review
options.description: Review shape: prepend diff hunks and direct callers for each changed file (use with --changed-since). [default: False]

options.name: --no-cache
options.description: Disable per-file reduction caching. [default: False]

options.name: --clear-cache
options.description: Clear the .fuse/cache directory before running. [default: False]

options.name: --index
options.description: Cache dependency/symbol analysis on disk (.fuse/index) to speed up repeated scoped runs. [default: False]

options.name: --watch
options.description: Watch for file changes and re-run fusion after edits settle. [default: False]
